formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p43_t1_calu_scalar_gepp_chain (H : Nat) (a : Nat -> Real) (u r q : Real) (ha : forall i, i <= H -> a i != 0) : exists L U, P43LUFactSpec (H+2) (p43Chain H a u r q) L U and U (p43Last H) (p43Last H) = q - r / a 0 * u
formal_statement.plain_language: The scalar sparse chain in Theorem 3.4, equation (3.5), has an exact unit-lower/upper factorization whose final upper entry is the original trailing scalar minus the CALU rank-one update.

informal_proof: Use the exact factorization of the first Schur complement recursively along the scalar reduction-tree chain. Each elimination step removes the current pivot row and produces the next shorter chain. The alternating final-row sign cancels the intermediate transformed entries, leaving q-r/a_0*u in the last upper entry.
informal_statement: Prove the b=1, k=0, arbitrary-height specialization of Theorem 3.4's sparse GEPP factorization (3.5), including its final updated entry.
